description: Implement the molecule processing module that converts molecular information into quantum computation inputs using Tencirchem-ng 2024.10.

objectives.description: Implement the process_molecule() function and MoleculeData dataclass as defined in RLQAS specification section 3.1
acceptance_criteria: Implement process_molecule() function with all required parameters
Create MoleculeData dataclass with all required fields
Integrate with Tencirchem-ng 2024.10 for molecular integrals and Hamiltonian generation
Support basic test molecules: H₂, LiH, BeH₂
Implement proper error handling for invalid inputs
Write unit tests covering H₂ (2 qubits) and LiH (4 qubits) cases

system_requirements: cuda=12.4 (optional, for GPU acceleration if available)

implementation_requirements: Function process_molecule() must match specification interface
Dataclass MoleculeData must contain all fields: hamiltonian, n_qubits, reference_state, fci_energy, molecular_info
Must use Tencirchem-ng for molecular integrals and Hamiltonian generation
output_requirements: Ralph learning log documenting iterative learning and design decisions
computational_limits: Focus on test molecules: H₂, LiH, BeH₂
Should run on standard compute resources
verification_points: process_molecule() correctly processes H₂ molecule (2 qubits)
process_molecule() correctly processes LiH molecule (4 qubits)
MoleculeData dataclass contains all required fields
Integration with Tencirchem-ng works without errors
All unit tests pass with >80% coverage
Error handling works for invalid inputs

validation_procedure.description: Implementation must be validated through unit tests and integration tests
steps: Implement the module according to specifications
Write comprehensive unit tests covering all functionality
Test with example molecules: H₂ at 0.74 Å, LiH at 1.6 Å, BeH₂ at 1.3 Å
Document any issues and fix them iteratively
success_criteria: Module can be imported without errors

technical: MoleculeData dataclass contains all required fields
Unit tests cover all major functionality
Error handling for invalid inputs works
process: Ralph completes the objective within maximum iterations
Knowledge about molecular processing and Tencirchem-ng captured in AGENTS.md
Detailed documentation of implementation decisions and rationale
Ralph learning log demonstrates iterative learning and problem-solving
integration_readiness: Module provides clean interface for quantum simulator module (Phase 1 Task 002)
Output format compatible with UCC search module (Phase 1 Task 004)
Code is modular and extensible for future enhancements

reference_materials.example_implementations: Existing H2 and LiH test cases in ralph/test directory

notes: This is the foundation module for RLQAS Phase 1
Focus on correctness and clean interfaces rather than optimization
Ensure the module can handle different fermion-to-qubit transformations
Document any assumptions or limitations in the implementation
